@startuml FIG-CL-TAV-01 skinparam shadowing false title FIG-CL-TAV-01 Context
SysML 1.6 notation-based views; executable/metamodel conformance is not claimed
subset of context relations; satisfy/verify are model relations, not executed verification
actor Operator node TestAdapter node IUT node NetworkClock cloud Integrity645 as "645 integrity boundary
identity bound; capability NOT-ESTABLISHED"
Operator --> TestAdapter : test request TestAdapter --> IUT : stimulus IUT --> TestAdapter : observation Izk TestAdapter --> NetworkClock : time / error bound IUT ..> Integrity645 : call and state only
not algorithm evidence TestAdapter --> Msess : observation port to verification session note bottom of IUT Protocol messages and operation states belong to Mprot, not to Msess. end note @enduml
svg.text: SysML 1.6 notation-based views; executable/metamodel conformance is not claimed
